summary: Implemented P3 source-presence onboarding in AlembicPlugin. Status now runs a bounded SourcePresenceProbe only for uninitialized workspaces, includes sourcePresence in onboarding, keeps empty and ghost-empty needs_init quiet, and adds a host-visible post-init alembic_bootstrap recommendation only when source files are detected. The recommendation uses startsDaemon=false and no bootstrap/job side effects; needs_bootstrap and other four-tool/onboarding contracts remain unchanged. Committed as e7dda4f Add source-aware status onboarding.
